summary: Frontend-only test (admin@mikilab.de) of the two new features. (1) Piano Settimanale 'Ultimo salvataggio' INSIDE the tool: verified label present on load from weekly.updated_at, updates after save (toast 'Weekly plan saved'), persists after leaving ('Back to tools') and re-opening the tool — PASS. (2) Recipe favourites: heart toggle (aria-pressed true/false + red fill), stopPropagation (no recipe dialog opens), localStorage 'mikilab_fav_recipes' persistence across reload, 'Preferite (N)' counter chip, fav filter shows only favourites (results bar 2/120), 'Azzera filtri' resets favFilter, empty-state message 'No favourites yet. Tap the heart...' — all PASS. Regression: clicking card body still opens detail dialog — PASS. One UX defect found: with the Preferite filter active the favourite cards remain hidden because category folders are collapsed by default (favFilter is not part of the 'searching' auto-open condition).

ui_bugs.issue: Activating 'Preferite (N)' on a fresh load shows the results bar (e.g. '2 recipes') and the category folder header, but ZERO recipe cards are visible because folders are closed by default. The auto-open condition `const searching = query.trim() !== '' || baseFilter !== 'all'` does not include favFilter. Fix: include `|| favFilter` (and ideally catFilter) so folders open when the favourites filter is on.

issues: React hydration/DOM warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from PianoProduzioneAI.jsx (rendered inside Maestro line 232). Invalid markup inside <option>, should be plain text.

action_items: RecipeList.jsx: include favFilter in the `searching` flag so category folders auto-expand when the 'Preferite' filter is active (currently favourite cards are invisible until the user manually opens each folder).
PianoProduzioneAI.jsx: remove <span> (icon/badge markup) from inside <option> elements to clear the React DOM nesting error.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeList.jsx is 1308 lines — should be split (Card, filters bar, dialog) per file-size guideline.
Favourites are stored only in localStorage, so they are per-browser and NOT per-user across devices; if per-user persistence is expected, back it with the user profile API.
WeeklyPlan.jsx: savedAt set from client `new Date()` after save instead of the server-returned updated_at — minor clock-drift risk, acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Saved a weekly plan for admin (Monday: 2 items) via the tool; favourites toggled and cleaned from localStorage at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI language defaults to EN in the test browser, so labels appear as 'Last saved:' and 'Favourites (N)'. Recipe cards live inside collapsible folders (cat-folder-<key>) that are CLOSED by default — you must click a folder before recipe-row-<id>/recipe-fav-<id> exist in the DOM. Known fav recipe ids used: a052ba40-408a-495d-885a-6d7be260f3e9, a72f2b01-d0d0-4159-8569-8280ade0ec0b. Weekly plan tool: nav-tab-maestro -> maestro-top-settimana; exit via 'Back to tools'.
rca_of_the_issue: Fav filter invisibility: in RecipeList.jsx the grouped rendering opens a category folder only when `searching` (query or baseFilter) is truthy; favFilter is excluded, so filtered favourites are rendered inside collapsed AnimatePresence blocks and never displayed on first activation.
